description: Exact unrestricted unit-cost byte edit distance.

forward: Sentinel matrix H uses the last source row containing each target byte and the most recent matching target column. H[i+1,j+1] minimizes insertion, deletion, substitution and H[p,q]+(i-p-1)+1+(j-q-1). The transposition can be followed by further edits, unlike OSA. Rows and columns represent prefix distances with one sentinel offset.
